parsed.summary: After tracing power rails, the CAN/Serial crystal values, the e-stop/LED buffers, the LTC4412 USB path, the GLOBAL_EN switch, and the HDMI/CAN/USB interfaces, the schematic matches the specification's intended architecture; the only deviations I could spot (e.g. the 16 MHz CAN crystals Y1/Y3, the 14.7456 MHz serial crystals Y2/Y4, the crossed-out JP17/JP4/JP20 jumpers, the polyfuse-not-to-HDMI-spec note, the POE inverted-output note, and the absence of a GLOBAL_EN delay chip) are all either functionally correct or explicitly documented in the spec as known issues/open TODOs, so no real anomaly is supported by the drawing.
